Governance.metaDescription: Meet the board, node coordinators, and honorary advisors of the Startup and Innovation Cluster (CSI) A.C.
Governance.heroDescription: The people who lead and coordinate the ecosystem, with clear responsibilities and accountability.
Governance.boardDescription: The cluster's board: government, academia, and industry working together.
Governance.boardYamilDescription: Legal representative of the cluster. Responsible for institutional vision and strategic alliances.
Governance.boardAlvaroDescription: Coordinates the day-to-day operation of the ecosystem and the articulation between nodes, committees, and partners.
Governance.coordinatorsDescription: Leaders of each level in the ecosystem.
Governance.coordinatorsRodrigoDescription: Manages access to capital, public calls, and funding instruments.
Governance.coordinatorsDanielDescription: Drives the development and validation of technological solutions with industry.
Governance.coordinatorsOmarDescription: Runs the events, networks, and programs that keep the entrepreneurial community alive.
Governance.coordinatorsLeninDescription: Administers the spaces and laboratories of the CERHAN II Hub.
Governance.coordinatorsMargaritaDescription: Leads the training and placement of the ecosystem's talent.
Governance.coordinatorsJuanAlbertoDescription: Coordinates the working committees and the participation of cluster volunteers.
Governance.honoraryDescription: People who have made outstanding contributions to the ecosystem and advise the cluster as honorary members.
Governance.transparencyText: The cluster's operational authority rests with the board and node coordinators, while legal representation belongs exclusively to the president. Every institutional decision is recorded in meeting minutes and reported to the members of the association.
Governance.vigilanciaDescription: The cluster's supervision and transparency body.
